blurb: Guests rent various pontoon and sport boats for cruising, watersports like tubing, skiing, and wakeboarding on Shuswap Lake and Mara Lake. Boats accommodate groups from 9 to 14 people and include safety equipment and a full orientation. Rentals include one watersports item and optional tubes and toys for an extra fee.
